main_text.p: qui de Juramentis fcripfere ( quod fci-am ) praetermiffa , ea eft qua diftin-guitur in Affertorium & Promissorium. Quum enim in omni Juramento, ut ante dictum eft, affumatur à jurante nomen Dei per modum invocationis in teftimonium rei alicujus dubiæ : advertendum eft id poffe contingere tribus modis. Poteft enim res aliqua in dubium vocari, vel de praeterito, Itáne fuerit, vel non fuerit : ut vidiftine heri Caium in foro, vel non vidifti ? Vel de praesenti, Itáne fit, vel non fit : ut, Habefne pecunias quas apud te depofui, vel non habes ? Vel denique de futuro, Itáne futurum fit, vel non : ut Dabifne mihi cras mutuo centum vel non dabis ? Quoties ergo adhibito Juramento Deus advocatur in teftimonium rei praeteritæ, vel praesentis, dici folet ejufmodi Juramentum Affertorium : quia jurans, finè ulla in futurum fponfione, afferit tantùm rem ita effe vel fuiffe ficut ipfe tunc jurat. Quod fi Deus interpofito juramento invocetur in teftimonium rei futuræ, dicitur Juramentum Promissorium: quia jurans polllicetur fe aliquid in posterum facturum vel non facturum. Affertorii ufus præcipuus eft in judiciis, ad lites terminandas maximè in Quæftione facti : Promissorii exiguus usus eft in judiciis ; fed in Promissis, pactionibus & contractibus plurimus. Extan[?]

page.notes: The scan is cropped at the right edge, so the last letters of many lines are cut off. Words were read from the visible letters and from the continuation on the next line; where a line end is not clear, the reading is given as seen. The stray stroke beside "alicujus" and the dark spots on the left are not printed text and are left out. The last line before the catchword ends at "Extan", which is cut off by the scan edge; the catchword "facr" is partly visible and uncertain. The printed "Quod" and "Promissorii" are read as printed; the long s is written as a plain s.
